mapper.sql: create_time , update_time, version, bool_delete_enum, id, is_default, remark, status, template_name
mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.name, d.id AS deptId, d.name AS deptName FROM sys_user as u INNER JOIN sys_template_user_link as pul ON pul.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN sys_department as d ON u.department_id = d.id WHERE pul.template_id = #{id} and u.bool_delete_enum = 0 and d.bool_delete_enum = 0 and pul.bool_delete_enum = 0 ORDER BY d.name, u.id
SELECT id FROM sys_template_user_link where template_id = #{id} and bool_delete_enum = 0
